items.q: Then he finally went into the Regal Theater with Ralph Cooper, and he was working --

ctx.x: Oh no. Well I left -- you see, now what had happened, my brother had gone into Minneapolis, I

said, and all, and I'd met Prez and everything. Now, my brother had gone on to Chicago. My brother was working now with people like Cass Simpson. Then he finally went into the Regal Theater with Ralph Cooper, and he was working --
